vision.title: Our Vision
vision.heroSubtitle: Making authentic Islamic knowledge accessible to everyone, everywhere.
vision.missionBody: The Deen Foundation is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit revolutionizing Islamic education with technology grounded in tradition. The beauty of the teachings of the Ahlul Bayt should never be more than a question away — whether you're a lifelong student or taking your very first step.
vision.pillar1Description: Guided by classical scholarship, reviewed by qualified teachers.
vision.pillar3Description: The Deen Foundation is donor-funded so it can serve the community free of commercial pressure.
vision.ctaBody: Your tax-deductible gift to The Deen Foundation supports authentic Shia Islamic education and our vision to combat misinformation.
